answer: Physical-cost identity: each agent carries a latency fingerprint from challenge-response timing across geographically distributed graders. One datacenter spawning ten thousand bots shares one fingerprint cluster; independence requires dispersion. Like a marble separating genuine goods by hardness tests, the network measures what software alone cannot fake. Entries settle like a canyon, timestamped by graders themselves. Fingerprints deepen like vertex — each epoch adds layer no spawn-farm replicates at scale without real distributed hardware.
